The Navien NPF700-100U5CH is a condensing hydro furnace in an upflow cabinet, modulating from 14,000 to 100,000 BTU on natural gas or propane (convertible).

A hydro furnace heats the air through water: a condensing burner heats water inside the cabinet, and a water-to-air coil hands that heat to the duct air. The combustion side and the air side stay separate, and the wide modulation range lets it run long and low on mild days instead of short-cycling.

The upflow cabinet discharges out the top, for a basement or a mechanical closet ducted upward.

As a condensing appliance it needs a condensate drain, with a neutralizer where code or the receiving pipe calls for one, and sealed venting sized for a condensing unit; an existing atmospheric flue is not reusable. Compare all Navien hydro furnaces.
